dataItem.name: Label_PriorValues
dataItem.expression: case when ?p_timeview?='MTD' and ?_as_of_date? > date('2022-01-31') then _add_months(?_as_of_date?,-1) when ?p_timeview?='QTD' and ?_as_of_date? > date('2022-03-31')then _add_months(?_as_of_date?,-3) when ?p_timeview?='YTD' and ?_as_of_date? > date('2022-12-31') then _add_years(?_as_of_date?,-1) else null end
